$comment: The coverage gate (tools/ci/coverage-cli.ts, run by `npm run coverage`, the local gate and CI). Floors are percentages, and each source folder (tools/, plugins/teamrig-pane/) must meet the total floors on its own. An exception lowers one file's floors and needs a reason a reviewer accepted; never lower the total or per-file floors to pass a change. unmeasured lists code no node test can load yet: it is named here, never hidden, and the gate fails once a test loads it.

unmeasured.plugins/teamrig-pane/hooks/register.tsx: The engine's entry: JSX and the engine's runtime (atom, read, update from claude-code), which node cannot load. tests/pane.test.ts drives every hook it registers, under `claude plugin test`, whose runner reports no coverage.
unmeasured.plugins/teamrig-pane/scripts/sync-core.t: A maintainer's script run against a teamrig checkout at the pinned commit; its logic is scripts/vendor.ts, measured here. Its own reads and writes have no test yet.
unmeasured.plugins/teamrig-pane/scripts/golden.ts: A maintainer's script that runs teamrig's CLI from a checkout at the pinned commit to capture tests/golden-register.ts; golden.test.ts holds the pane to that capture. Its own steps have no test yet.

vendored.plugins/teamrig-pane/hooks/core/: teamrig's read modules, copied byte for byte by scripts/sync-core.ts at the pinned commit; teamrig's own coverage gate measures them.

engineTests.plugins/teamrig-pane/tests/pane.test.ts: Its tests take the engine ($, on): they mount the pane and answer the engine's effects, which only `claude plugin test` provides.
